articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones attacked four Russian regions. In two cities, they damaged residential buildings.
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck industrial facilities in Ufa overnight on August 19, Bashkortostan Governor Radiy Khabirov said. articles.title_en: Russia’s biggest state development corp fires Andrei Klepach, its chief economist, for saying in May that Moscow is losing its war of attrition with the West, and losing it ‘in some ways’ to Ukraine
articles.lead_en: The Russian state development corporation VEB.RF has fired its chief economist, Andrey Klepach.
